activeLunaDiagnostic.finding: Prompt wording did not control ImageGen output dimensions; semantic centers also drifted. The generic-prism Blender revision was produced afterward and has not been tested.

triggerPinLunaDiagnostic.status: failed-before-generation; usage limit; superseded because the guide aspect was wrong

annotatedGuideLunaDiagnostic.finding: The model literalized the annotated event vocabulary into five isolated structures and failed to construct a coherent town screen. Its automated self-review is not accepted.

nextSemanticProof.shapeNeutralScope: Projection audit generated from map camera, lane, events, anchors, and trigger radii; retained as a diagnostic rather than the preferred model input.
nextSemanticProof.semanticPrimitives: Every transition uses the same triangular prism pointed at its trigger origin. Blue = edge exit; red = door; yellow = upward route; magenta proxy = actor scale. Marker volume never expresses route shape or extent.
nextSemanticProof.outputTransform: Author and render the coherent 1065x240 frame first; compress that completed raster to the model's 3:1 landscape canvas; add annotations only afterward. Apply one complete-frame 3:1-to-1065x240 transform to generated output; never render a second camera aspect, crop, or stitch.
nextSemanticProof.nextPrompt: Create one complete 3:1 pre-rendered early-90s CGI background of a town map in a side-scroller RPG, like a PSX screenshot. St. Maria is a damp Portuguese colonial town built in steep tiers above its port. This is the port: from left to right it links the quay, an active forge, Laura's smithy, the uphill way to the Cortico, and the long climb to the churchyard. Shipping, and one hull that has not moved in a long time. Nothing between here and the horizon. A few inhabitants are present. Image 1 is the aesthetic reference. Image 2 is where ingame events are placed.
rules: Do not generate weather variants until this proof passes.
No generated image may be used as a positive reference.
Exactly two visual inputs: image 1 is the in-house live-capture sheet and image 2 is the pre-distorted annotated Blender event-placement guide.
Describe image 2 only as where ingame events are placed; do not explain its symbols, camera, geometry, or transform.
Do not give the model the clean guide, final-aspect preview, generated candidates, or any other visual input.
Include inhabitants in the first pass.
Reject missing, blocked, depth-incoherent, or UI-obscured transitions before aesthetic ranking.
Do not move gameplay anchors without an owner-approved remap proposal.
